source.check: returned unopposed: the News-Letter (8 May 1952, p. 6) names four candidates (Brennan, Morrison, Gray, G. A. E. Roberts); 'Mr. Roberts, the nominee for Clifton Ward, has also withdrawn, which means no contest in that area' and 'all retiring members are returned' (North Down Herald, 10 May 1952, p. 1, page image read)

note: Municipal elections, 21 May 1952. Castle Ward was the only contest printed. After withdrawals Castle Ward was the only contest (North Down Herald, 10 May 1952, p. 1). Aldermen for Ballyholme, Castle and Dufferin wards and the councillors of Ballyholme, Clifton and Dufferin wards were returned unopposed (Herald and News-Letter nominations reports); Princetown's retiring members were returned unopposed but are not named in the sources searched (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). David Morrison thanked the electors for 'again returning me unopposed' (North Down Herald, 17 May 1952, p. 6). Returned unopposed.
